s1e04.c01: In a narrow alley, the baby penguin follows a trail of cooking smoke with its nose, while the hamster courier carrying a parcel trails behind.
s1e04.c02: A row of alley restaurants: the neighboring shop has a long line while the tiny restaurant at the end is empty, smoke rising from its chimney.
s1e04.c03: Through the window, a cat chef alone among empty tables grills fish, flipping it lazily.
s1e04.c04: The baby penguin presses its face to the window, drooling, while the hamster tugs its backpack to pull it away.
s1e04.c05: The door opens; the sleepy-eyed cat chef only twitches its ears and points to an empty seat with a ladle.
s1e04.c06: The two sit at the table and the cat chef sets down a plate with a burnt black fish.
s1e04.c07: The baby penguin takes a bite and its fluff stands on end; the hamster secretly stuffs its portion into its cheek.
s1e04.c08: The cat chef looks around the empty tables and its ears droop; the baby penguin peeks toward the kitchen.
s1e04.c09: In the kitchen a polar bear sleeps hugging an igloo fridge; the cat chef struggles to pull out a fish by its tail.
s1e04.c10: A basket of floppy fish with one shiny fish among them; the cat chef picks one at random.
s1e04.c11: The baby penguin sniffs and points its flipper right at the shiny fish.
s1e04.c12: The cat chef grills that fish with a suspicious look; it turns golden and crispy.
s1e04.c13: The cat chef takes a bite; its half-closed eyes pop wide open and its tail stiffens straight up.
s1e04.c14: The cat chef lifts the baby penguin by its backpack handle onto a kitchen chair, the fish-picking spot.
s1e04.c15: Teamwork: the penguin picks fish, the cat grills, and the hamster tries to pocket a plate but gets blocked by a ladle.
s1e04.c16: Chimney smoke spreads through the alley and the noses of the customers in the other line all turn at once.
s1e04.c17: Customers rush in, the empty tables fill up, and a giraffe pokes only its neck through the window.
s1e04.c18: The cat chef cooks keeping rhythm with a ladle, face deadpan but tail swishing happily.
s1e04.c19: The smell wakes the polar bear, who opens the igloo door and offers out a fish.
s1e04.c20: Night: plates are stacked like towers and the three lie sprawled on the floor, exhausted.
s1e04.c21: The cat chef silently hands over two fish skewers wrapped in paper.
s1e04.c22: The hamster shows the footprint stamp on the parcel and shrugs; the baby penguin presses its foot to it.
s1e04.c23: The cat chef points with a ladle at a picture poster on the wall.
s1e04.c24: Close-up of the picture poster: snowflake train, lighthouse beach, ship, iceberg with penguins, three suns and a boat; slow push-in.
s1e04.c25: The baby penguin and the hamster count the suns one by one, their eyes widen, and the pebble in the backpack glows brightly.

s1e05.c01: At a hilltop station at night, a snowflake train puffs steam mixed with snowflakes; the baby penguin and the hamster arrive panting on the platform.
s1e05.c02: At the ticket booth a squirrel clerk takes acorns, stuffs them in its cheeks and hands out leaf tickets; the two at the end of the line have nothing.
s1e05.c03: The baby penguin turns its backpack upside down and shakes out a pebble, a map and a fish skewer; no acorns.
s1e05.c04: Trains wait on both sides of the platform; the baby penguin opens the map and confidently points at the right-hand train.
s1e05.c05: A badger porter loads parcel boxes onto the freight car with a cart; the hamster's eyes sparkle.
s1e05.c06: The hamster points at a big empty box and taps its courier cap; the baby penguin takes a step back.
s1e05.c07: Inside the box, the two sit squeezed together while the pebble glow lights their faces.
s1e05.c08: The porter stamps a snowflake stamp on the box with a thump; two pairs of eyes peek through the handle hole.
s1e05.c09: In the freight car the box lid opens and two heads pop up; a box in the corner wiggles by itself.
s1e05.c10: The snowflake train runs across night fields, snowflakes swirling from its chimney.
s1e05.c11: The two sneak in through the carriage door; a sheep grandma knits and a migratory bird navigator hangs from the ceiling ring.
s1e05.c12: The far door opens and a raccoon conductor enters clicking a ticket punch; passengers hold out tickets.
s1e05.c13: Hiding under a seat, the red backpack sticks out and the conductor's feet stop right in front of it.
s1e05.c14: As the conductor bends down, the sheep grandma holds out her ticket and the two tiptoe away.
s1e05.c15: Hiding inside the sheep grandma's big ball of yarn, only faces and a cap show while she keeps knitting innocently.
s1e05.c16: The conductor peers suspiciously at the yarn ball, clicking the punch.
s1e05.c17: A hedgehog snack cart rolls by with skewers, apples and donuts on its spikes, a trail of smell rising.
s1e05.c18: The baby penguin slides out of the yarn following the smell; the hamster grabs the backpack and the yarn unravels.
s1e05.c19: The baby penguin covered in yarn locks eyes with the conductor.
s1e05.c20: A chase down the aisle: the two run, the conductor follows, a long trail of yarn behind.
s1e05.c21: At the last carriage door there is nowhere to go and the conductor approaches.
s1e05.c22: The hamster shows the parcel footprint stamp and the baby penguin holds out a fish skewer with trembling flippers.
s1e05.c23: The conductor takes a bite of the skewer and its eyes curve into happy half-moons.
s1e05.c24: The conductor punches a snowflake-shaped hole in the corner of the parcel with a click.
s1e05.c25: The two sit side by side at the window; the bird navigator points toward the back of the train and dawn brightens outside.
